notes: 2.3.1: biome scans are now command-only. The background timer that scanned region files every scan-seconds is removed - the map only updates when /bridge biomes rescan all (or rescan <dim>/now) is run. scan-seconds was dropped from the biomes remote config. 2.3.0 rev 3 (included): read the top biome layer of the highest section properly and accept single-biome sections that omit the data array, so chunks no longer come back hollow. rev 2 (included): parse the lowercase 'sections' root tag and byte-typed section Y (1.18+ format) - the first rev parsed 0 chunks on modern region files. After updating, run /bridge biomes rescan all once to (re)fill the map. Requires the 20260101000300_biomes migration (and the 20260101000500_biomes_snapshot RPC for the website).
